title: add-benchmark-lab-performance-suites-reporting-pipeline-v129
author: Maya Thompson
body: Motivation: expand the benchmark lab with a new set of performance test suites, profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and an improved reporting pipeline to reduce manual post-processing and speed up comparisons across kernel/quantization variants. This PR bundles multiple related changes to make end-to-end runs turnkey for kernel-selection and adaptive-batching experiments. Summary of changes: 1) performance suites: added new suites for mixed-small, mixed-large, long-context and streaming workloads; each suite includes workload definitions, input corpora, and expected latency/throughput targets. 2) profiling baselines: synthetic and representative baselines for cold-start and steady-state, including kernel-selection hooks and KV-cache warmup traces. 3) representative workload runners: new runners for streaming video-captioning style workloads and long-context retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) scenarios; runners support pluggable batching policies, simulated client distributions, and token-level tracing. 4) reporting pipeline: new Airflow DAG and a lightweight aggregator service to normalize run outputs into the existing reporting schema, with CSV + BigQuery sinks and a preview dashboard in Grafana. 5) telemetry and CI: added test harnesses to the CI matrix to run small smoke benchmarks and added new alerting thresholds for regression detection. Backwards compatibility and safety: defaults unchanged; new suites are opt-in and gated behind the benchmark-lab config flag (bench_v129_enabled). Checklist: - [x] add performance suites and workload definitions - [x] add profiling baseline configs and synthetic inputs - [x] add representative runners and batching policy adapters - [x] implement reporting DAG + aggregator service - [x] CI matrix updates and smoke tests - [x] update docs and README with runbook and dashboard links How to run locally: set BENCH_CONFIG=bench_v129_enabled, run ./benchmark-lab/run_local.sh --suite mixed-large --runner streaming-ru, or use the provided 'quick-run' script for a 5-minute smoke run. Production rollout plan: enable bench_v129_enabled in staging, run a full battery of profiling baselines and verify KV-cache traces look consistent with historical runs, then enable in prod for scheduled runs. Risks and mitigations: larger reporting outputs may increase BigQuery costs; aggregator uses sampling and compression by default to limit ingestion. Related work: links to Linear tickets: ENG-1289, ENG-1376; prior PRs that iterated on the pipeline: pr-68990, pr-712345.
commits: feat(bench): add mixed-small and mixed-large test suites
feat(bench): add long-context and streaming workload runners
chore(reports): add Airflow DAG + aggregator service
test(ci): add smoke benchmark job to CI matrix
review_comments: Jordan Liu: Please add a short note in the runbook describing the sampling strategy used by the aggregator (risk: BigQuery costs).
Maya Thompson: Added sampling notes and configuration knobs to docs/runbook-v129.md; default sampling = 0.1 for production scheduled runs.
Priya Patel: The streaming runner looks good; can we add an option to simulate jittered client arrivals?
Maya Thompson: Added --jitter-factor flag and unit tests for jittered distributions.
Ethan Ramirez: CI bench-smoke is flaky in the first run, timed out once. Can we make it retry on transient infra failures?
Maya Thompson: Changed bench-smoke job to retry 2 times on transient errors and pin the test VM image to stable-2025-01-10.
Priya Patel: Approving after docs update and CI green.
release_notes: Added benchmark-lab v129: new performance test suites (mixed-small, mixed-large, long-context, streaming), profiling baselines for cold-start and steady-state, representative workload runners, and an automated reporting pipeline with BigQuery+Grafana integration. Opt-in behind bench_v129_enabled flag.
notes: Post-merge: scheduled a follow-up to run full profiling battery in staging (ENG-1422). Dashboard and dataset ACLs were provisioned; analytics team notified.
